subject: PAR

context.en-US: Purified PAR polymer delivered into cortical neurons kills ~50% at 80 nM (mean 40-mer) and ~80% as ≥60-mer fractions, with toxicity from 20 nM; PARG or phosphodiesterase 1 predigestion abolishes killing while poly(A) charge control is nontoxic, proving the polymer itself is the parthanatos death signal (Andrabi et al. 2006 PNAS).
context.zh-TW: 純化 PAR 聚合物导入皮质神经元在 80 nM 杀死约50%，≥60-mer 组分约80%致死，20 nM 起即有毒性；PARG 或磷酸二酯酶1预消化消除毒性，poly(A) 对照无毒，证明聚合物本身即 parthanatos 死亡信号。

source_document: _document_ - Parthanatos Andrabi 2006 PAR polymer death signal.md

context.en-US: Cytosolic PAR colocalizes with mitochondria minutes after NMDA stimulation and triggers AIF release and nuclear translocation; PARG overexpression prevents NMDA-induced AIF translocation and MNNG-nuclei-derived PAR releases AIF from isolated mitochondria (Andrabi 2008; David 2009).
context.zh-TW: 胞质 PAR 在 NMDA 刺激后数分钟即与线粒体共定位并触发 AIF 释放与核转位；PARG 过表达阻止该转位，MNNG 细胞核来源 PAR 可从分离线粒体释放 AIF。

subject: PARG

context.en-US: PARG hydrolyzes PAR glycosidic bonds via endo/exoglycosidase activity; recombinant PARG predigestion of purified PAR abolishes neuronal and HeLa killing, and cytosolic PARG overexpression lowers cytosolic PAR after NMDA (Andrabi et al. 2006).
context.zh-TW: PARG 以内切/外切糖苷酶活性水解 PAR 糖苷键；重组 PARG 预消化消除对神经元与 HeLa 的杀伤，胞质 PARG 过表达降低 NMDA 后胞质 PAR。

source_document: _document_ - Parthanatos Andrabi 2006 PAR polymer death signal.md

subject: PARG

context.en-US: PrP-driven PARG transgenic mice show 62% smaller hemisphere infarct after 120-min MCAO while PARG heterozygotes show 56% larger infarct after 90-min MCAO with matched perfusion and temperature, establishing bidirectional PARG-dosage control of stroke outcome (Andrabi et al. 2006).
context.zh-TW: PrP 驱动 PARG 转基因小鼠 120 分钟 MCAO 后半球梗死缩小62%，而 PARG 杂合子 90 分钟 MCAO 后增大56%，证实 PARG 剂量双向决定卒中结局。

source_document: _document_ - Parthanatos Andrabi 2006 PAR polymer death signal.md

subject: Parthanatos

context.en-US: Parthanatos is caspase-independent: z-VAD-fmk fails to block purified-PAR killing in neurons and HeLa or MNNG/NMDA death, and PAR does not directly activate caspases; it shows shrunken condensed nuclei with PI positivity rather than apoptotic bodies (Andrabi 2006; Andrabi 2008).
context.zh-TW: Parthanatos 为 caspase 非依赖：z-VAD 不能阻断纯化 PAR、MNNG/NMDA 杀伤，PAR 亦不直接激活 caspase；形态为皱缩浓缩核伴 PI 阳性而非凋亡小体。

source_document: _document_ - Parthanatos Andrabi 2006 PAR polymer death signal.md

context.en-US: NAD+ depletion alone cannot explain parthanatos: energy-replete cells die from delivered PAR, anti-PAR/PARG rescue without restoring bulk energetics, mitochondrial NAD+ stays physiological during genotoxic stress, and Bax/calpain KOs survive MNNG despite massive NAD+ drops (David 2009 review of Berger suicide hypothesis).
context.zh-TW: NAD+ 耗竭不足以解释 parthanatos：能量充足细胞仍死于外源 PAR，抗 PAR/PARG 挽救不依赖整体能量恢复，基因毒应激时线粒体 NAD+ 维持生理水平，Bax/calpain KO  massive NAD+ 下降仍存活。

context.en-US: AIF is the parthanatos executioner downstream of PAR: PARP-1-KO cells fail to release AIF, AIF knockdown or neutralizing antibodies reduce death, and Harlequin mice (~80% AIF reduction) resist NMDA, purified PAR, excitotoxic lesions and stroke with rescue by re-expression (Andrabi 2008; David 2009).
context.zh-TW: AIF 为 PAR 下游 parthanatos 执行者：PARP-1 KO 细胞不释放 AIF，敲低/中和抗体减轻死亡，Harlequin 小鼠（AIF 降低约80%）抵抗 NMDA、纯化 PAR 与卒中，回补恢复敏感性。

context.en-US: ARH3 (39-kDa ADP-ribose-(arginine) hydrolase) has PARG-like activity toward PAR glycosidic bonds alongside PARG, but does not compensate PARG-knockout lethality in mice or Drosophila nor the trophoblast PAR-accumulation death, indicating a minor role in parthanatos (Andrabi 2008; David 2009).
context.zh-TW: ARH3（39 kDa）具类 PARG 活性可切割 PAR 糖苷键，但不能代偿小鼠/果蝇 PARG 敲除致死与滋养层 PAR 累积死亡，在 parthanatos 中作用次要。

context.en-US: Bax-knockout fibroblasts resist PARP-1-dependent death with compromised AIF release, but Bcl-2 overexpression only delays rather than blocks death and the 12-h window leaves delay-vs-rescue unresolved, so BAX as obligatory AIF-release pore downstream of PAR remains a candidate (Andrabi 2008; David 2009).
context.zh-TW: Bax 敲除成纤维细胞抵抗 PARP-1 依赖死亡且 AIF 释放受损，但 Bcl-2 过表达仅延迟不阻断，12 小时窗口无法区分延迟与挽救，故 BAX 作为 PAR 下游 AIF 释放孔仍为候选。

subject: Caspase-8

context.en-US: Active caspase-8 (often as caspase-8/cFLIP-L heterodimer) cleaves RIPK1, RIPK3, CYLD and TRIF to suppress necrosome formation; its inhibition or deletion flips TNFR1/Fas/TRAIL signaling from extrinsic apoptosis to RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL necroptosis, the two-precondition trigger of the pathway (Dhuriya & Sharma 2018).
context.zh-TW: 活化 caspase-8（常为 caspase-8/cFLIP-L 异二聚体）切割 RIPK1、RIPK3、CYLD 与 TRIF 以抑制 necrosome 形成；其抑制或缺失将 TNFR1/Fas/TRAIL 信号从外源性凋亡翻转为 RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL necroptosis，为该通路双前提触发条件。

source_document: _document_ - Necroptosis a regulated inflammatory mode of cell death.md

subject: RIPK3

context.en-US: RIPK3 directly activates inflammasome formation via caspase-8-mediated and NLRP3-mediated arms leading to caspase-1/11 cleavage of IL-1beta; whether MLKL is obligatory is contested since MLKL ablation preserves NLRP3 activation and cytokine production in some models (Dhuriya & Sharma 2018).
context.zh-TW: RIPK3 经 caspase-8 介导与 NLRP3 介导双臂直接激活炎症小体，导致 caspase-1/11 切割 IL-1beta；MLKL 是否必需存争议，因部分模型中 MLKL 缺失仍保留 NLRP3 活化与细胞因子产生。

source_document: _document_ - Necroptosis a regulated inflammatory mode of cell death.md

subject: ZBP1

context.en-US: ZBP1/DAI and TLR3/4-TRIF carry RHIM domains that form non-classical necrosomes directly with RIPK3 without RIPK1; TRIF lacks kinase activity so its RIPK3 activation is mechanistically distinct, and RIPK1 inhibition does not impair TLR3-mediated necroptosis (Dhuriya & Sharma 2018).
context.zh-TW: ZBP1/DAI 与 TLR3/4-TRIF 具 RHIM 结构域，可不经 RIPK1 直接与 RIPK3 形成非经典 necrosome；TRIF 无激酶活性故激活机制不同，RIPK1 抑制不影响 TLR3 介导的 necroptosis。

source_document: _document_ - Necroptosis a regulated inflammatory mode of cell death.md

subject: RIPK3

context.en-US: SOD1-G93A transgenic ALS mice show reduced axonal degeneration and motor dysfunction upon RIPK3 silencing or Nec-1 treatment; OPTN mutation initiates RIPK1-dependent axonopathy and sporadic-ALS astrocytes kill neighboring motor neurons via RIPK1/MLKL necroptosis blocked by necrosulfonamide or RIPK1 knockdown (Dhuriya & Sharma 2018).
context.zh-TW: SOD1-G93A ALS 转基因小鼠经 RIPK3 沉默或 Nec-1 处理轴突变性与运动障碍减轻；OPTN 突变启动 RIPK1 依赖性轴突病变，散发 ALS 星形胶质细胞经 RIPK1/MLKL necroptosis 杀伤邻近运动神经元，可被 necrosulfonamide 或 RIPK1 敲低阻断。

source_document: _document_ - Necroptosis a regulated inflammatory mode of cell death.md

subject: 24(S)-Hydroxycholesterol

context.en-US: Ester-form 24(S)-hydroxycholesterol inhibits amyloid-beta production at physiological concentration, but at high concentration it induces non-apoptotic programmed death in neuronal cells with low caspase-8 expression; controlling its level may therefore prevent onset of progressive neurodegeneration, placing 24S-OHC at the apoptosis/necroptosis fate boundary (Dhuriya & Sharma 2018).
context.zh-TW: 酯化型 24(S)-羟基胆固醇在生理浓度抑制淀粉样β生成，但在高浓度对低 caspase-8 神经元诱导非凋亡性程序性死亡；控制其水平或可预防进行性神经退行性疾病，位于凋亡/necroptosis 命運分界。

context.en-US: AIFM2 is the human gene encoding FSP1 (ferroptosis suppressor protein 1). Although originally characterized as pro-apoptotic, AIFM2 was renamed FSP1 after 2019 studies showed its dominant cellular role is suppressing ferroptosis at the plasma membrane as a flavoprotein ubiquinone oxidoreductase.
context.zh-TW: AIFM2 是人類編碼 FSP1（ferroptosis 抑制蛋白 1）的基因。雖然最初被歸類為促凋亡蛋白，2019 年的研究顯示其主要的細胞角色是在質膜上抑制 ferroptosis，作為黃素蛋白泛醌氧化還原酶，因而更名為 FSP1。

context.en-US: Cytochrome c released through BAX/BAK-permeabilized mitochondria binds Apaf-1 (apoptotic protease activating factor-1), which together with procaspase-9 assembles the heptameric apoptosome. Within this platform procaspase-9 is activated and in turn cleaves caspase-3, committing the cell to intrinsic apoptosis. The apoptosome is therefore the router that converts mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization into caspase-9 activation, and it is the very complex whose additional components (such as SIRT1 after caspase cleavage) reshape cell fate.
context.zh-TW: 經由 BAX/BAK 通透化的粒線體所釋出的 Cytochrome c 會結合 Apaf-1（凋亡蛋白酶活化因子-1），並與 pro-Caspase-9 共同組裝成七聚體凋亡體（apoptosome）。在此平台上 pro-Caspase-9 被活化，進而切割 Caspase-3，使細胞走向內在凋亡。凋亡體因此是將粒線體外膜通透化轉換為 Caspase-9 活化的路由器，也正是 SIRT1（在 caspase 切割後）重塑細胞命運時所處的複合體。

context.en-US: Bad is a BH3-only sensitizer: rather than activating BAX/BAK directly, it displaces anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family restraint (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1), indirectly liberating the effectors. IKK-mediated phosphorylation of Bad at Ser26 inactivates it and confers TNFα resistance, and the BH3 mimetic compounds act on the same principle — competitively disrupting Bcl-2/Bcl-xL binding to beclin-1 as well, which releases beclin-1 for autophagy.
context.zh-TW: Bad 是 BH3-only 的敏化因子：它不直接活化 BAX/BAK，而是置換抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族（Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1）的抑制，間接解放效應蛋白。IKK 對 Bad Ser26 的磷酸化會使其失活並賦予 TNFα 抗性；BH3 擬似劑也基於相同原理——競爭性破壞 Bcl-2/Bcl-xL 與 beclin-1 的結合，同時釋出 beclin-1 以促進自噬。

context.en-US: Activated BAX (with BAK) drives opening of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore, causing cytochrome c to diffuse into the cytosol where it nucleates the apoptosome with Apaf-1 and caspase-9. BH3-only activators (Bid, Bim, PUMA) can directly engage BAX/BAK, while sensitizers (Bad, Noxa, Bik) displace the anti-apoptotic Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, and Mcl-1 restraint. The pore event is the point of no return separating transcriptional death decisions from caspase execution.
context.zh-TW: 活化的 BAX（與 BAK）會驅動粒線體通透性轉換孔開啟，使 cytochrome c 擴散進入細胞質，並與 Apaf-1 及 Caspase-9 組裝凋亡體。BH3-only 活化因子（Bid、Bim、PUMA）可直接結合 BAX/BAK，而敏化因子（Bad、Noxa、Bik）則置換抗凋亡的 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 與 Mcl-1。孔道開啟是區分轉錄層面死亡決定與 caspase 執行的不可逆節點。

context.en-US: Bid is a BH3-only direct activator: in the absence of anti-apoptotic restraint it can directly bind and trigger BAX (and BAK), bypassing the need for sensitizer displacement. In the extrinsic pathway, caspase-8 cleavage of Bid (tBid) routes death-receptor signals into the intrinsic mitochondrial arm in type II cells, and in ischemia-reperfusion injury models caspase-1 cleavage of Bid likewise converts pyroptotic signaling into mitochondrial apoptosis when gasdermin pores are unavailable.
context.zh-TW: Bid 是 BH3-only 的直接活化因子：在缺乏抗凋亡抑制時，它可直接結合並觸發 BAX（與 BAK），無需敏化因子的置換。在外在路徑中，caspase-8 對 Bid 的切割（tBid）使死亡受體訊號在 type II 細胞中轉入內在粒線體臂；而在缺血再灌注損傷模型中，Caspase-1 對 Bid 的切割同樣可在 gasdermin 孔道缺席時，將焦亡訊號轉為粒線體凋亡。

context.en-US: Caspases are a conserved family of cysteine-aspartate proteases that function as central regulators of apoptosis and inflammation. Initiator caspases sense death signals while executioner caspases dismantle the cell, placing caspases at the heart of the apoptotic program.
context.zh-TW: Caspase 是保守的半胱氨酸-天門冬氨酸蛋白酶家族，是細胞凋亡與發炎的核心調控者。起始型 caspase 感知死亡訊號，執行型 caspase 則分解細胞，使 caspase 位居細胞凋亡程式的核心。

context.en-US: In ischemia-reperfusion injury, caspase-1 cleaves the BH3-only protein Bid, converting pyroptotic signaling into mitochondrial apoptosis. In gasdermin-D-deficient cells, caspase-1 drives the full Bid/caspase-9/caspase-3 apoptotic cascade — sometimes followed by GSDME-dependent pyroptosis to eliminate uncleared apoptotic bodies. This demonstrates that inflammasome sensors can trigger apoptosis when the pyroptotic executor is missing, a physiologically relevant mechanism in cells with minimal GSDMD expression such as neurons and mast cells.
context.zh-TW: 在缺血再灌注損傷中，Caspase-1 會切割 BH3-only 蛋白 Bid，將焦亡訊號轉為粒線體凋亡。在 gasdermin-D 缺陷細胞中，Caspase-1 可驅動完整的 Bid/Caspase-9/Caspase-3 凋亡級聯——有時隨後再以 GSDME 依賴的焦亡清除未被清理的凋亡小體。這證明當焦亡執行者缺席時，發炎體感應器也能觸發細胞凋亡；此機制在 GSDMD 表達極低的細胞（如神經元與肥大細胞）中具生理相關性。

context.en-US: Inflammasome-activated caspase-1 cleaves Parkin, the E3 ligase essential for PINK1/Parkin mitophagy, halting the mitophagy pathway. Caspase-1 simultaneously enhances mitochondrial ROS production, permeabilization, and fragmentation, pushing damage beyond mitophagy's repair capacity. This is the pyroptosis-to-mitophagy inhibitory arm: lytic inflammatory death not only runs ahead of mitochondrial cleanup but actively dismantles it — although ambient ozone exposure studies show ROS can also activate PINK1-Parkin mitophagy upstream of NLRP3 pyroptosis, so the relationship is bidirectional and context-dependent.
context.zh-TW: 發炎體活化的 Caspase-1 會切割 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬所必需的 E3 連接酶 Parkin，使粒線體自噬路徑中止。Caspase-1 同時加劇粒線體 ROS 的產生、通透化與片段化，使損傷超出粒線體自噬的修復能力。這是焦亡至粒線體自噬的抑制臂：發炎性裂解死亡不只跑在粒線體清理之前，還主動拆解它——不過臭氧暴露研究顯示 ROS 也可在 NLRP3 焦亡的上游活化 PINK1-Parkin 粒線體自噬，因此兩者關係是雙向且取決於情境的。

context.en-US: Apoptotic caspases-3 and -7 cleave active gasdermin D (GSDMD) at the non-canonical aspartate-88 site, inactivating its pore-forming N-terminal fragment and thereby suppressing pyroptosis. Because these apoptotic caspases activate more slowly than caspase-1, this acts as a delayed negative-feedback brake: the inflammasome initiates pyroptosis, and the slower apoptotic arm damps it to prevent excessive inflammation. The nature of the death ultimately produced depends on which gasdermin substrate is available — GSDMD (inhibited by caspase-3/-7) versus GSDME (activated by caspase-3).
context.zh-TW: 凋亡性的 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-7 會在非典型天門冬胺酸-88 位點切割活化的 gasdermin D（GSDMD），使其成孔的 N 端片段失活，從而抑制焦亡。由於這些凋亡 caspases 的活化比 Caspase-1 慢，這形成延遲的負回饋剎車：發炎體啟動焦亡，而較慢的凋亡臂則抑制過度發炎。最終產生的死亡型態取決於可用的 gasdermin 受質——GSDMD（被 Caspase-3/-7 抑制）或 GSDME（被 Caspase-3 活化）。

context.en-US: Caspase-3 cleaves gasdermin E (GSDME), releasing its N-terminal pore-forming domain and converting apoptosis into pyroptosis. The outcome is dictated by GSDME expression level: in GSDME-high cancer cells, chemotherapy-activated caspase-3 drives pyroptotic lysis; in GSDME-low settings, GSDME instead acts upstream of caspase-3, reinforcing classical apoptosis. This caspase-3/GSDME switch is the clearest demonstration that the caspase substrate — not the caspase itself — determines the death modality.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-3 會切割 gasdermin E（GSDME），釋出其成孔的 N 端片段，使細胞凋亡轉為焦亡。結果由 GSDME 的表達量決定：在 GSDME 高表達的癌細胞中，化療活化的 Caspase-3 驅動焦亡裂解；在 GSDME 低表達的情境下，GSDME 反而作為 Caspase-3 的上游活化因子，強化典型細胞凋亡。Caspase-3/GSDME 開關最清楚地表現出：決定死亡型態的是 caspase 的受質，而非 caspase 本身。

context.en-US: In the extrinsic (death receptor) pathway, FasL or TNF-α engagement assembles the DISC, activating initiator caspase-8 (with caspase-10), which directly cleaves the executioner caspase-3 in type I cells. In type II cells caspase-8 instead cleaves Bid, routing through mitochondria. Caspase-8 sits at the crossroads of apoptosis, necroptosis, and pyroptosis because its active form also cleaves RIPK1 and RIPK3, preventing necroptosis — so caspase-8-to-caspase-3 flow is simultaneously a death signal and a necroptosis suppressor.
context.zh-TW: 在外在（死亡受體）路徑中，FasL 或 TNF-α 的結合組裝出 DISC，活化起始 caspase-8（與 caspase-10），其在 type I 細胞中直接切割執行者 Caspase-3；在 type II 細胞中 caspase-8 則切割 Bid，改經粒線體路徑。Caspase-8 位於細胞凋亡、程序性壞死與細胞焦亡的十字路口，因為其活化形式也會切割 RIPK1 與 RIPK3 從而阻止程序性壞死——因此 caspase-8 至 Caspase-3 的流動既是死亡訊號，也是程序性壞死的抑制者。

context.en-US: Erastin, the prototype class-I ferroptosis inducer, blocks the cystine/glutamate antiporter system xc- (SLC7A11), depleting intracellular cysteine and thereby glutathione. Without GSH, GPX4 cannot reduce lipid peroxides, and iron-driven Fenton chemistry plus LOX-mediated oxidation accumulate lethal lipid peroxides. Erastin additionally induces ER stress that activates the CHOP-PUMA axis, recruiting apoptosis on top of ferroptosis — a combined-death approach relevant to cancer therapy.
context.zh-TW: Erastin 是第一類鐵死亡誘導劑的原型，會阻斷胱胺酸/麩胺酸反向轉運蛋白 system xc-（SLC7A11），耗竭細胞內胱胺酸進而耗盡麩胱甘肽。缺乏 GSH 時，GPX4 無法還原脂質過氧化物，鐵驅動的 Fenton 化學與 LOX 介導的氧化便累積致命的脂質過氧化物。Erastin 還會誘導內質網壓力、活化 CHOP-PUMA 軸線，在鐵死亡之上疊加細胞凋亡——這是與癌症治療相關的複合死亡策略。

context.en-US: Executioner caspases are the terminal proteases of the apoptotic cascade that dismantle the cell. In aging, senescent-cell resistance to executioner-caspase killing via SCAPs is a barrier to senescent-cell clearance, linking executioner-caspase biology to senescence persistence.
context.zh-TW: 執行型 caspase 是分解細胞的細胞凋亡級聯末端蛋白酶。在衰老中，衰老細胞經由 SCAPs 對執行型 caspase 殺傷的抵抗是衰老細胞清除的障礙，將執行型 caspase 生物學與衰老持續相連結。

context.en-US: Gasdermin E (GSDME, formerly DFNA5) is cleaved by executioner caspase-3, releasing its N-terminal pore-forming domain. In GSDME-high cells, chemotherapy-activated caspase-3 converts the death program from quiet apoptosis into lytic, inflammatory pyroptosis; in GSDME-low settings GSDME instead acts upstream of caspase-3. PINK1-mediated mitophagy suppresses caspase-3/GSDME-dependent pyroptosis in postoperative cognitive dysfunction, tying mitophagy competence to which death modality prevails.
context.zh-TW: Gasdermin E（GSDME，舊稱 DFNA5）會被執行者 Caspase-3 切割，釋出其成孔的 N 端片段。在 GSDME 高表達的細胞中，化療活化的 Caspase-3 會將死亡程序由安靜的細胞凋亡轉為裂解性、發炎性的焦亡；在 GSDME 低表達時，GSDME 反而位於 Caspase-3 的上游。PINK1 介導的粒線體自噬會抑制術後認知功能障礙中 Caspase-3/GSDME 依賴的焦亡，將粒線體自噬能力與何種死亡模式勝出連結起來。

context.en-US: Heme oxygenase-1 has a biphasic relationship with ferroptosis. Mild damage: HO-1 expression stimulates mitophagy and disposal of damaged mitochondria, disposing of redox-active iron and reducing ferroptosis (as in cisplatin acute kidney injury via the ROS/HO-1/GPX4 axis). Sustained overexpression: HO-1 catabolizes heme into free iron, downregulates GPX4, and promotes lipid peroxidation and ferroptosis (as in TNBC cells). The direction depends on damage severity and HO-1 expression duration.
context.zh-TW: 血紅素加氧酶-1（HO-1）與鐵死亡之間呈雙相關係。輕度損傷時：HO-1 的表達會促進粒線體自噬並清除受損粒線體，處理具氧化還原活性的鐵而降低鐵死亡（如經由 ROS/HO-1/GPX4 軸線的 cisplatin 急性腎損傷）。持續過表達時：HO-1 將血紅素分解為游離鐵、下調 GPX4，促進脂質過氧化與鐵死亡（如 TNBC 細胞）。方向取決於損傷嚴重度與 HO-1 表達的持續時間。

context.en-US: Inflammatory caspases such as Caspase-11, Caspase-4, and Caspase-5 cleave IL-1α as well as Gasdermin D. Gasdermin-D cleavage forms pyroptotic pores while IL-1α processing shapes the SASP, linking non-canonical inflammasome signaling to senescence-associated inflammation.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-11、Caspase-4、Caspase-5 等發炎性 caspase 會剪切 IL-1α 與 Gasdermin D。Gasdermin D 剪切形成焦亡孔道，IL-1α 處理則塑造 SASP，將非典型發炎體訊號與衰老相關發炎相連結。

context.en-US: Liproxstatin-1 is a spiroquinoxalinamine small molecule that inhibits ferroptosis by suppressing lipid peroxidation as a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant. It has demonstrated in vivo efficacy in mouse models of ferroptosis-driven pathologies.
context.zh-TW: Liproxstatin-1 是螺喹噁啉胺小分子，作為親脂自由基捕捉抗氧化劑抑制脂質過氧化來阻斷 ferroptosis。它在ferroptosis 驅動病理的小鼠模型中展現體內療效。

context.en-US: Mitophagy primarily restrains ferroptosis by disposing of damaged, ROS-leaking mitochondria and by regulating iron translocation (mitoferrins, Fe-S clusters) between matrix and cytoplasm. The relationship is bidirectional, however: complex I inhibition (BAY 87-2243) can drive PINK1-dependent mitophagy that raises ROS and promotes ferroptosis, FUNDC1 can deliver GPX4 to lysosomes promoting ferroptosis, and O-GlcNAc transferase inhibition couples ferritinophagy and mitophagy to ferroptosis sensitivity. Net effect is context-dependent — governed by ROS level, iron availability, and the receptor engaged.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體自噬主要透過清除滲漏 ROS 的受損粒線體、並調節基質與細胞質之間的鐵轉運（mitoferrin、Fe-S cluster）來抑制鐵死亡。然而此關係是雙向的：Complex I 抑制（BAY 87-2243）可驅動 PINK1 依賴的粒線體自噬而升高 ROS 並促進鐵死亡；FUNDC1 可將 GPX4 送入溶酶體促進鐵死亡；O-GlcNAc 轉移酶的抑制則將鐵蛋白自噬與粒線體自噬偶聯至鐵死亡敏感性。整體效應取決於 ROS 水平、鐵可用性與所動用的受體。

context.en-US: Activated MLKL attenuates autophagy following its translocation to intracellular membranes, meaning necroptosis does not merely co-occur with failing autophagy but actively suppresses it. Conversely autophagy can induce necroptosis through ROS byproducts — Baf-A1 (late-stage autophagy inhibition) downregulates RIP1/RIP3, and 3-MA (early inhibition) suppresses RIPK1/RIPK3 interaction — so the two pathways regulate each other in both directions, with TNF-induced necroptosis stimulating early autophagy (RIPK3-AMPK) while blocking late autophagosome-lysosome fusion.
context.zh-TW: 活化的 MLKL 在轉位至細胞內膜後會減弱自噬，這表示程序性壞死不只是伴隨自噬失能，還會主動抑制它。反過來，自噬也可透過 ROS 副產物誘導程序性壞死——晚期自噬抑制劑 Baf-A1 會下調 RIP1/RIP3，早期抑制劑 3-MA 會抑制 RIPK1/RIPK3 的交互作用——因此兩條路徑雙向調控彼此；TNF 誘導的程序性壞死會經 RIPK3-AMPK 刺激早期自噬，卻阻斷晚期的自噬體-溶酶體融合。

context.en-US: MLKL-driven plasma membrane rupture releases damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs), which immune cells recognize to eliminate harmful cells and initiate repair. When the inflammatory response remains uncontrolled, this same mechanism drives pathology: cancer, Alzheimer's, parkinsonism, multiple sclerosis, pulmonary, liver, enteric, and cardiac diseases. MLKL-mediated DAMP release is therefore the mechanistic bridge between necroptosis as a host-defense program and necroinflammatory chronic disease.
context.zh-TW: MLKL 驅動的細胞膜破裂會釋出損傷相關分子模式（DAMP），免疫細胞藉此辨識並清除有害細胞、啟動修復。當發炎反應失控時，同一機制便成為病理推手：癌症、阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症、多發性硬化症、肺、肝、腸道與心臟疾病。MLKL 介導的 DAMP 釋放因此是「程序性壞死作為宿主防禦程序」與「壞死性發炎慢性疾病」之間的機制橋樑。

context.en-US: MLKL pore formation at the plasma membrane triggers potassium efflux, which is a canonical activator of the NLRP3 inflammasome — establishing the RIPK3/MLKL/NLRP3 route by which necroptosis feeds pyroptosis. ASC oligomerization is reduced in MLKL-deficient cells, and RIPK3 can activate NLRP3 even without MLKL. This makes lytic necroptotic rupture a upstream driver of inflammatory interleukin maturation rather than a parallel endpoint.
context.zh-TW: MLKL 在細胞膜形成的孔道會引發鉀離子外流——這是 NLRP3 發炎體的典型活化訊號——從而建立 RIPK3/MLKL/NLRP3 路徑，使程序性壞死餵養焦亡。在 MLKL 缺陷細胞中 ASC 聚集減少，而 RIPK3 即使沒有 MLKL 也能活化 NLRP3。這表示裂解性的程序性壞死破裂是發炎性介白素成熟的下游驅動者，而非平行終點。

context.en-US: NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy degrades ferritin stores, expanding the labile iron pool that feeds Fenton chemistry and lipid peroxidation — the core ferroptotic engine. Pharmacological or genetic inhibition of O-GlcNAc transferase activates both ferritinophagy and mitophagy, increasing labile iron and ROS and sensitizing cells to ferroptosis. Iron chelators (deferoxamine, ciclopirox) and ferritinophagy blockade therefore act on the same supply-side node of ferroptosis regulation.
context.zh-TW: NCOA4 介導的鐵蛋白自噬會降解鐵蛋白儲存，擴大可動用鐵池，進而餵養 Fenton 化學與脂質過氧化——鐵死亡的核心引擎。藥理或遺傳抑制 O-GlcNAc 轉移酶會同時活化鐵蛋白自噬與粒線體自噬，增加可動用鐵與 ROS，並使細胞對鐵死亡敏感。因此鐵螯合劑（deferoxamine、ciclopirox）與阻斷鐵蛋白自噬都作用在鐵死亡調控的同一供給端節點。

context.en-US: Necrosulfonamide blocks the necroptotic executor MLKL, preventing its pore formation and membrane rupture in human cells. Notably, the same compound also functions as an inhibitor of gasdermin D — the pyroptotic pore-former — so necrosulfonamide dually suppresses the two lytic, DAMP-releasing death modalities. This dual activity makes it a useful tool for dissecting necroptosis-pyroptosis crosstalk, and highlights that MLKL and GSDMD pores share pharmacological vulnerability despite being activated by different cascades.
context.zh-TW: Necrosulfonamide 會阻斷程序性壞死的執行者 MLKL，在人類細胞中防止其形成孔道與膜破裂。值得注意的是，同一化合物也是 gasdermin D——焦亡的成孔蛋白——的抑制劑，因此 necrosulfonamide 可同時抑制兩種裂解性、釋放 DAMP 的死亡模式。這種雙重活性使其成為剖析程序性壞死與焦亡交互作用的实用工具，也突顯 MLKL 與 GSDMD 孔道雖由不同級聯活化，卻共享藥理脆弱性。

context.en-US: p53 promotes ferroptosis transcriptionally by repressing the SLC7A11 cystine/glutamate antiporter (limiting cysteine influx and GSH synthesis) and preventing GPX4 formation. The tumor suppressor's dual action is transcription-independent as well: p53 binds and blocks DPP-4, limiting ferroptosis. iASPP-mediated p53 inhibition activates SLC7A11 and halts ferroptosis, confirming the p53-SLC7A11 axis. This makes ferroptosis a p53-executed tumor suppression program distinct from its apoptotic roles.
context.zh-TW: p53 在轉錄層面促進鐵死亡：它抑制 SLC7A11 胱胺酸/麩胺酸反向轉運蛋白（限制胱胺酸流入與 GSH 合成），並阻止 GPX4 的形成。此腫瘤抑制蛋白也有不依賴轉錄的雙重作用：p53 會結合並阻斷 DPP-4，從而限制鐵死亡。由 iASPP 介導的 p53 抑制會活化 SLC7A11 並中止鐵死亡，確認了 p53-SLC7A11 軸線。這使鐵死亡成為 p53 執行的腫瘤抑制程序，有別於其細胞凋亡角色。

context.en-US: Nuclear p53 transcriptionally activates PUMA (p53 upregulated modulator of apoptosis), a BH3-only protein that binds and inhibits the anti-apoptotic BCL-xL. Because PUMA can act both as a direct activator of BAX/BAK and as a sensitizer that displaces anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family members, p53-PUMA signaling lowers the mitochondrial threshold for cytochrome c release. Cytoplasmic p53 additionally retains the ability to activate BAX and BAK directly.
context.zh-TW: 細胞核內的 p53 會轉錄活化 PUMA（p53 上調凋亡調控因子），一種可結合並抑制抗凋亡 BCL-xL 的 BH3-only 蛋白。由於 PUMA 既能直接活化 BAX/BAK，也能作為置換抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族成員的敏化因子，p53-PUMA 訊號降低了粒線體釋出 cytochrome c 的門檻。此外，細胞質型的 p53 仍可直接活化 BAX 與 BAK。

context.en-US: Parkin ubiquitinates the voltage-dependent anion channel VDAC on the mitochondrial outer membrane — a modification with dual cell-fate meaning: monoubiquitination of VDAC halts apoptosis, while polyubiquitination feeds PINK1/Parkin mitophagy. Parkin also ubiquitinates MFN1 and mitochondrial Rho GTPases, and regulates Drp1 activity and degradation. VDAC is therefore the point of intersection where the same E3 ligase executing mitophagy also restrains apoptotic permeabilization.
context.zh-TW: Parkin 會對粒線體外膜的電壓依賴性陰離子通道 VDAC 進行泛素化——此修飾具有雙重的細胞命運意義：VDAC 的單泛素化可阻止細胞凋亡，而多泛素化則驅動 PINK1/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬。Parkin 也會泛素化 MFN1 與粒線體 Rho GTPase，並調控 Drp1 的活性與降解。因此 VDAC 正是同一個 E3 連接酶在執行粒線體自噬之外、同時抑制凋亡通透化的交會點。

context.en-US: PGAM5 activates the GTP-binding fission protein Drp1, which translocates to mitochondria to drive the fission that both segregates damaged mitochondria for PINK1/Parkin mitophagy and, under severe RIPK3 activation, contributes to necroptotic mitochondrial rupture. The RIPK3-PGAM5-Drp1 route is thus a shared conduit: mild damage routes it to mitophagy, severe damage to necroptosis. Some studies contest the importance of PGAM5 in Drp1 activation, so the exact mechanism remains under investigation.
context.zh-TW: PGAM5 會活化 GTP 結合的分裂蛋白 Drp1，使其轉位至粒線體驅動分裂——此過程既能隔離受損粒線體供 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬之用，在強烈 RIPK3 活化下也促成程序性壞死的粒線體破裂。RIPK3-PGAM5-Drp1 路徑因此是共享通道：輕度損傷導向粒線體自噬，嚴重損傷導向程序性壞死。部分研究質疑 PGAM5 在 Drp1 活化中的重要性，其確切機制仍在研究中。

context.en-US: The mitochondrial phosphatase PGAM5 stabilizes PINK1 on damaged mitochondrial membranes and can attach to LC3, supporting PINK1/Parkin mitophagy. It simultaneously serves the necroptosis machinery by anchoring the necrosome and activating Drp1-driven fission. Which role dominates depends on damage severity: mild stress favors the PGAM5-PINK1 mitophagy arm (cell preservation), while severe RIPK3 activation shifts PGAM5-Drp1 toward necroptotic rupture.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體磷酸酶 PGAM5 會將 PINK1 穩定在受損的粒線體膜上並可結合 LC3，支持 PINK1/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬。同時它也服務於程序性壞死機器：錨定 necrosome 並活化 Drp1 驅動的分裂。何種角色占上風取決於損傷程度：輕度壓力偏向 PGAM5-PINK1 的粒線體自噬臂（細胞保存），而強烈的 RIPK3 活化則使 PGAM5-Drp1 轉向程序性壞死破裂。

context.en-US: PUMA neutralizes the anti-apoptotic BCL-xL, freeing BAX and BAK to permeabilize the mitochondrial outer membrane. Notably, PUMA is dual-function: it can act as a direct BAX/BAK activator (like Bid and Bim) or as a sensitizer (like Bad, Noxa, and Bik) that displaces Bcl-2-family restraint. This places p53-PUMA signaling at the point where transcriptional death decisions become mitochondrial permeabilization.
context.zh-TW: PUMA 會中和抗凋亡的 BCL-xL，釋放 BAX 與 BAK 以通透化粒線體外膜。值得注意的是 PUMA 具雙重功能：它既能像 Bid 與 Bim 一樣直接活化 BAX/BAK，也能像 Bad、Noxa 與 Bik 一樣作為敏化因子置換 Bcl-2 家族的抑制。這使 p53-PUMA 訊號正好位於轉錄層面的死亡決定轉換為粒線體通透化的節點。

context.en-US: RIPK3 phosphorylates MLKL on its activation loop (human Thr357/Ser358), exposing the N-terminal four-helix bundle that executes necroptosis. This phosphorylation is the final licensure step of the necrosome cascade: without it MLKL stays monomeric and inert. Phosphorylated MLKL then oligomerizes and traffics to the plasma membrane, where its four-helix bundles form cation channels. MLKL is a pseudokinase — it binds ATP but does not hydrolyze it — so its function is structural membrane disruption rather than signaling.
context.zh-TW: RIPK3 會將 MLKL 的活化環（人類 Thr357/Ser358）磷酸化，暴露出執行程序性壞死的 N 端四螺旋束。此磷酸化是 necrosome 級聯的最終許可步驟：缺少它時 MLKL 保持單體且不活化。磷酸化的 MLKL 隨後寡聚化並轉位至細胞膜，其四螺旋束在此形成陽離子通道。MLKL 是一種偽激酶——會結合 ATP 但不水解——因此其功能是結構性的膜破壞而非訊號傳遞。

context.en-US: RSL3 is the prototype class-II ferroptosis inducer: it directly inhibits glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4), the only enzyme that can reduce lipid hydroperoxides inside membranes. GPX4 inhibition makes the cell unable to neutralize lipid peroxides regardless of GSH supply, committing it to ferroptotic death. RSL3 synergy with autophagic GPX4 degradation (Fin56, copper) and its use alongside system-xc- blockers like erastin represent the two supply-side and effector-side strategies for triggering ferroptosis in cancer.
context.zh-TW: RSL3 是第二類鐵死亡誘導劑的原型：它直接抑制麩胱甘肽過氧化物酶 4（GPX4）——唯一能在膜內還原脂質氫過氧化物的酶。GPX4 受抑制後，無論 GSH 供應如何，細胞都無法中和脂質過氧化物，注定走向鐵死亡。RSL3 與自噬介導的 GPX4 降解（Fin56、銅）之間的協同，以及與 system xc- 阻斷劑（如 erastin）的並用，代表觸發癌症鐵死亡的供給端與效應端兩大策略。

context.en-US: SIRT1 is an upstream activator of PINK1/Parkin mitophagy — for example via the SIRT1-FOXO1/3-PINK1-Parkin axis recruited during exercise and stress adaptation. Sirtuins also drive mitophagy directly by post-translationally modifying mitophagy proteins (ATG5, ATG7, ATG8) or indirectly by inducing mTORC1-relieved, Parkin, beclin-1, and BNIP3 expression. Because mitophagy disposes of ROS-leaking damaged mitochondria, SIRT1's mitophagy arm connects NAD+ metabolism to both pyroptosis and ferroptosis suppression.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 是 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬的上游活化因子——例如在運動與壓力適應中招募的 SIRT1-FOXO1/3-PINK1-Parkin 軸線。Sirtuins 也能透過對粒線體自噬蛋白（ATG5、ATG7、ATG8）的轉譯後修飾直接驅動粒線體自噬，或間接透過解除 mTORC1 抑制並誘導 Parkin、beclin-1 與 BNIP3 的表達。由於粒線體自噬會清除滲漏 ROS 的受損粒線體，SIRT1 的這條路徑將 NAD+ 代謝與焦亡及鐵死亡的抑制串聯起來。

context.en-US: The AMPK/SIRT1 axis suppresses pyroptosis: colchicine activates AMPK, which upregulates SIRT1, whose anti-inflammatory histone deacetylation weakens the inflammatory tone, alleviates oxidative stress, and halts the pyroptotic process. SIRT1 also suppresses caspase-1-mediated pyroptosis via NRF2/PGC-1α signaling in Hirschsprung-associated enterocolitis models. Together with its suppression of NLRP3-priming NF-κB signaling, this makes SIRT1 an upstream rheostat of inflammasome-driven lytic death.
context.zh-TW: AMPK/SIRT1 軸線會抑制焦亡：colchicine 活化 AMPK，進而上調 SIRT1，其抗發炎的組蛋白去乙醯化可減弱發炎張力、緩解氧化壓力並中止焦亡過程。在希施斯普倫病相關腸結腸炎模型中，SIRT1 也透過 NRF2/PGC-1α 訊號抑制 Caspase-1 介導的焦亡。加上其對 NLRP3 致敏所需 NF-κB 訊號的抑制，SIRT1 成為發炎體驅動裂解死亡的上游調節器。

context.en-US: In myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, abnormalities in the SIRT1-SIRT3 axis inhibit PINK1/Parkin-mediated mitophagy, which raises mitochondrial ROS and activates ferroptosis. Restoring the axis therefore protects against ferroptotic cardiac injury. This places the mitochondrial sirtuins upstream of ferroptosis via mitophagy competence, complementary to SIRT3's direct deacetylation control of antioxidant enzymes (MnSOD K68/K122, IDH2) that determines the ROS burden feeding lipid peroxidation.
context.zh-TW: 在心肌缺血再灌注損傷中，SIRT1-SIRT3 軸線的異常會抑制 PINK1/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬，進而升高粒線體 ROS 並活化鐵死亡。因此恢復該軸線可保護心臟免於鐵死亡損傷。這使粒線體 sirtuins 透過粒線體自噬能力位於鐵死亡的上游，並與 SIRT3 對抗氧化酶（MnSOD K68/K122、IDH2）的直接去乙醯化控制互補——後者決定餵入脂質過氧化的 ROS 負荷。

context.en-US: SIRT3 activates AMPK/Parkin-mediated mitophagy (for example via the FOXO3a/PINK1-Parkin route in retinal pigment epithelial cells under high glucose), and simultaneously suppresses NLRP3 inflammasome activation by lowering mitochondrial ROS in human macrophages. In myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, abnormalities in the SIRT1-SIRT3 axis silence PINK1/Parkin mitophagy, raising ROS and activating ferroptosis — making the SIRT1/SIRT3 pair a joint upstream gate for mitophagy and, through it, for multiple death modalities.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 會活化 AMPK/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬（例如高糖環境下視網膜色素上皮細胞中的 FOXO3a/PINK1-Parkin 路徑），並在人類巨噬細胞中藉由降低粒線體 ROS 抑制 NLRP3 發炎體的活化。在心肌缺血再灌注損傷中，SIRT1-SIRT3 軸線的異常會沉默 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬，升高 ROS 並活化鐵死亡——使 SIRT1/SIRT3 這一對成為粒線體自噬（進而及於多種死亡模式）的共同上游閘門。

context.en-US: SIRT3 — a key mitophagy regulator — decreases NLRP3 inflammasome activation in human macrophages by reducing ROS, for example in electrical-stimulation models of Val-boroPro-induced pyroptosis. Because mtROS is a canonical second signal for NLRP3 assembly, SIRT3's control of mitochondrial redox places it upstream of inflammasome priming. Quercetin's promotion of mitophagy and MSC-exosome-mediated mitophagy suppression of microglial pyroptosis act on the same axis, while Parkin additionally restrains NF-κB via A20 induction.
context.zh-TW: 作為粒線體自噬的關鍵調節者，SIRT3 藉由降低 ROS 抑制人類巨噬細胞中 NLRP3 發炎體的活化（例如在 Val-boroPro 誘導焦亡的電刺激模型中）。由於 mtROS 是 NLRP3 組裝的典型第二訊號，SIRT3 對粒線體氧化還原的控制使其位於發炎體致敏的上游。Quercetin 促進粒線體自噬、以及間質幹細胞外泌體促進粒線體自噬以抑制小膠細胞焦亡，都作用在同一軸線上；此外 Parkin 亦可透過誘導 A20 抑制 NF-κB。

context.en-US: TNF-α binding to TNFR1 assembles complex I (RIPK1, TRADD, TRAF2, LUBAC, cIAP1, CYLD, NEMO). When NF-κB activation is suppressed, RIPK1 deubiquitinates and assembles complex IIa (ripoptosome) with FADD, TRADD, and pro-caspase-8 for apoptosis; with cIAP1 inhibited, complex IIb forms. Only when caspase-8 is absent or inhibited does RIPK1 recruit RIPK3 and MLKL into the necrosome — making TNF signaling a three-way fate decision in which the necrosome is the final, caspase-suppressed branch.
context.zh-TW: TNF-α 與 TNFR1 結合會組裝 complex I（RIPK1、TRADD、TRAF2、LUBAC、cIAP1、CYLD、NEMO）。當 NF-κB 活化受抑制時，RIPK1 去泛素化並與 FADD、TRADD 及 pro-Caspase-8 組裝出 complex IIa（ripoptosome）以進行細胞凋亡；當 cIAP1 受抑制時則形成 complex IIb。只有當 caspase-8 缺席或受抑制時，RIPK1 才會招募 RIPK3 與 MLKL 組成 necrosome——使 TNF 訊號成為三向的命運決定，而 necrosome 是 caspase 受壓制後的最終分支。

context.en-US: This is the most fundamental sex difference in the vault's cell-death biology: under stress, cells of female (XX) origin preferentially undergo caspase-dependent apoptosis (controlled, non-inflammatory), while male (XY) cells preferentially die by PARP-1/AIF-dependent necrosis (uncontrolled, proinflammatory). The divergence is cell-autonomous, persisting in hormone-free media and prepubertal animals, with major implications for stroke, MI, neurodegeneration and cancer therapy.
context.zh-TW: 這是資料庫細胞死亡生物學中最根本的性別差異：在壓力下，女性（XX）來源的細胞優先進行依賴 caspases 的凋亡（受控、非發炎），而男性（XY）細胞則偏好 PARP-1/AIF 依賴的壞死（不受控、促發炎）。此差異具細胞自主性，在無荷爾蒙培養基與青春期前動物中皆持續存在，對中風、心肌梗塞、神經退化與癌症治療具重大意義。

context.en-US: Estrogen-driven Bcl-2 upregulation raises the female apoptotic threshold: post-ischemic Bcl-2 is >60% higher in female brains (Dubal et al., J Neurosci 1999), and both BAX knockout (Forger et al., PNAS 2004) and Bcl-2 overexpression (Zup et al., J Neurosci 2003) eliminate sex differences in neuron number — establishing the Bcl-2/BAX axis as the genetic basis of sex differences in cell number.
context.zh-TW: 雌激素驅動的 Bcl-2 上調提高女性凋亡閾值：缺血後女性腦部 Bcl-2 升高逾 60%（Dubal 等，J Neurosci 1999）；BAX 基因剔除（Forger 等，PNAS 2004）與 Bcl-2 過量表現（Zup 等，J Neurosci 2003）皆能消除神經元數目的性別差異——確立 Bcl-2/BAX 軸為細胞數目性別差異的基因基礎。

context.en-US: PARP-1 is the male-preferred death effector: XY cells die via PARP-1/AIF-dependent necrosis rather than caspases. PARP-1 knockout protects males from ischemic brain injury but exacerbates damage in females, and loss of PARP-1 abrogates estradiol's neuroprotective potential — the mirror image of the XX-caspase arm.
context.zh-TW: PARP-1 是男性偏好的死亡效應因子：XY 細胞經 PARP-1/AIF 依賴的壞死而非 caspases 死亡。PARP-1 基因剔除保護雄性免於缺血性腦損傷，但在雌性卻加重損傷，且失去 PARP-1 會取消雌二醇的神經保護潛能——此為 XX-caspase 分支的鏡像。

context.en-US: Caspases are the executioner proteases of the female-preferred (XX) death arm: female cells show higher and earlier caspase-3 (Liu et al., Stroke 2009) and ~3x greater, uniquely nuclear-translocating caspase-8 (Sharma et al., ASN Neuro 2011) after ischemia, and pan-caspase inhibition protects females but not males in experimental stroke.
context.zh-TW: Caspases 是女性偏好（XX）死亡分支的執行蛋白酶：缺血後女性細胞的 caspase-3 較高且更早（Liu 等，Stroke 2009），caspase-8 約 3 倍且具 XX 特有的核轉位（Sharma 等，ASN Neuro 2011），而廣效 caspase 抑制在實驗性中風中僅保護雌性而對雄性無效。

context.en-US: Caspases are the female-preferred death effectors in the XX-caspase / XY-PARP-1-AIF framework. Caspase-3/8 activation is higher and earlier in female (XX) cells and neurons after ischemia, and pan-caspase inhibition protects females but not males in experimental stroke.
context.zh-TW: Caspases 是 XX-caspase / XY-PARP-1-AIF 架構中女性偏好的死亡效應因子。缺血後女性（XX）細胞與神經元的 caspase-3/8 活化較高且較早，而廣效 caspase 抑制在實驗性中風中僅保護雌性。

context.en-US: Estrogen transcriptionally induces Bcl-2 (neuroprotection): post-ischemic Bcl-2 is >60% higher in female brains (Dubal et al., J Neurosci 1999; Alkayed et al., 2001). Estrogen also upregulates Bcl-w and downregulates Bim (Patterson et al., J Neurosci 2007). The higher female Bcl-2/Bax ratio favors survival and apoptotic resistance, and post-MI apoptosis is ~10x higher in men (25.9%) than women (2.6%) (Biondi-Zoccai et al., Heart 2005).
context.zh-TW: 雌激素在轉錄層面誘導 Bcl-2（神經保護）：缺血後女性腦部 Bcl-2 升高逾 60%（Dubal 等，J Neurosci 1999；Alkayed 等，2001）。雌激素亦上調 Bcl-w 並下調 Bim（Patterson 等，J Neurosci 2007）。女性較高的 Bcl-2/Bax 比值有利存活與凋亡抗性，而心肌梗塞後凋亡在男性（25.9%）約為女性（2.6%）的 10 倍（Biondi-Zoccai 等，Heart 2005）。

context.en-US: Estrogen-driven Bcl-2 sets the female anti-apoptotic setpoint that raises the apoptotic threshold on the XX-caspase arm of the unified cell-death framework. Because tumors in women face a higher apoptotic threshold, Bcl-2-family-dependent drug resistance in cancers such as Breast Cancer and Prostate Cancer must be interpreted through a sex-hormonal lens; senolytic BH3 mimetics (e.g., Navitoclax/ABT-263) target these same pro-survival proteins.
context.zh-TW: 雌激素驅動的 Bcl-2 設定女性的抗凋亡基準點，在統一細胞死亡架構的 XX-caspase 分支上提高凋亡閾值。由於女性腫瘤面對較高的凋亡閾值，乳癌與攝護腺癌等癌症中依賴 Bcl-2 家族的藥物抗藥性必須以性荷爾蒙觀點詮釋；衰老溶解 BH3 擬似物（如 Navitoclax/ABT-263）即靶向這些同類促存活蛋白。

context.en-US: Active caspase-8 cleaves RIPK1/RIPK3 to suppress necroptosis; its inhibition flips TNF signaling to necroptosis. Inhibition is the fate-switch mechanism.
context.zh-TW: 活化 caspase-8 切割 RIPK1/RIPK3 以抑制程序性壞死；其抑制將 TNF 訊號翻轉為壞死。抑制是命運開關機制。

context.en-US: RIPK1 scaffolds and activates RIPK3 to assemble the necrosome. Activation is the kinase relay of the cascade.
context.zh-TW: RIPK1 支架化並活化 RIPK3 以組裝 necrosome。活化是級聯的激酶接力。

context.en-US: Necrostatin-1 is the defining tool inhibitor of RIPK1 kinase activity. Inhibition blocks necrosome assembly.
context.zh-TW: Necrostatin-1 是 RIPK1 激酶活性的定義性工具抑制劑。抑制阻斷 necrosome 組裝。

context.en-US: Necroptosis is the programmed subform of necrotic death. Classification nests the regulated program in necrosis.
context.zh-TW: 程序性壞死是壞死性死亡的程序性子型。歸類將調控程序嵌套於壞死。

context.en-US: Necrotic rupture spills DAMPs that drive sterile inflammation. Release is the lytic-to-immune coupling.
context.zh-TW: 壞死破裂溢出 DAMP 驅動無菌發炎。釋放是裂解到免疫的耦合。

context.en-US: Necrotic DAMP release prominently induces inflammation via TLR/RAGE/NLRP3. Induction is the pro-inflammatory outcome.
context.zh-TW: 壞死 DAMP 釋放經由 TLR/RAGE/NLRP3 顯著誘發發炎。誘發是促發炎結果。

context.en-US: TRAIL death-ligand engagement activates initiator caspase-8 at the DISC. Activation is the extrinsic entry point.
context.zh-TW: TRAIL 死亡配體接合在 DISC 活化起始 caspase-8。活化是外源進入點。

context.en-US: FasL engagement activates initiator caspase-8 at the DISC. Parallel entry to the TRAIL edge.
context.zh-TW: FasL 接合在 DISC 活化起始 caspase-8。與 TRAIL 邊平行的進入。

context.en-US: Caspase-8 directly cleaves executioner caspase-7 in type I cells. Activation parallels the caspase-3 edge.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-8 在 I 型細胞直接切割執行 caspase-7。活化與 caspase-3 邊平行。

context.en-US: p53 transcriptionally represses the cystine/glutamate antiporter, limiting GSH synthesis for ferroptosis execution. Erastin phenocopies this suppression pharmacologically.
context.zh-TW: p53 在轉錄抑制胱胺酸/麩胺酸反向轉運體，限制 GSH 合成以執行鐵死亡。Erastin 在藥理表型複製此抑制。

context.en-US: Cystine import through system Xc- sustains GSH supply that brakes ferroptosis. Protection is the reverse of the Erastin inhibition edge.
context.zh-TW: 經由 system Xc- 的胱胺酸輸入維持 GSH 供應以煞車鐵死亡。保護是 Erastin 抑制邊的反向。

context.en-US: The catalytic selenocysteine is essential for GPX4 peroxidase activity. Requirement links mevalonate-pathway tRNA maturation to ferroptosis defense.
context.zh-TW: 催化性硒半胱胺酸對 GPX4 過氧化酶活性必要。必要性將甲羥戊酸路徑 tRNA 成熟連結到鐵死亡防禦。

context.en-US: LPCAT3 remodels phosphatidylethanolamine with ACSL4-charged PUFA for peroxidation. Promotion completes the ACSL4 remodeling axis.
context.zh-TW: LPCAT3 以 ACSL4 活化的 PUFA 重塑磷脂醯乙醇胺以供過氧化。促進完成 ACSL4 重塑軸。

context.en-US: Artesunate triggers ROS-dependent ferroptosis in pancreatic, ovarian and head-and-neck models. Induction extends the inducer set beyond erastin/RSL3.
context.zh-TW: Artesunate 在胰臟、卵巢與頭頸模型觸發 ROS 依賴鐵死亡。誘發將誘發劑集合延伸至 erastin/RSL3 之外。

context.en-US: NRF2-driven antioxidant and iron-control programs suppress ferroptotic death via the p62-Keap1 axis. Suppression is the transcriptional brake.
context.zh-TW: NRF2 驅動的抗氧化與鐵控制程序經由 p62-Keap1 軸抑制鐵死亡。抑制是轉錄煞車。

context.en-US: Transferrin-receptor iron import supplies the labile iron feeding Fenton chemistry. Promotion is the iron-supply arm.
context.zh-TW: Transferrin 受體鐵輸入供應餵養 Fenton 化學的可動用鐵。促進是鐵供應臂。

context.en-US: Parthanatos is a regulated cell death program defined by PARP1 hyperactivation, PAR signaling, and AIF/MIF-dependent large-scale DNA fragmentation, distinct from caspase-dependent apoptosis and accidental necrosis.
context.zh-TW: Parthanatos 是一種受調控的細胞死亡程序，由 PARP1 過度活化、PAR 訊號傳遞以及 AIF/MIF 依賴的大尺度 DNA 片段化所定義，不同於 caspase 依賴的 apoptosis 與意外的 necrosis。

context.en-US: Severe DNA damage hyperactivates PARP1, generating long branched PAR polymers that translocate to mitochondria and trigger AIF release, committing the cell to parthanatos instead of DNA repair.
context.zh-TW: 嚴重 DNA 損傷使 PARP1 過度活化，產生長分支 PAR 聚合物，轉位至粒線體並觸發 AIF 釋放，使細胞走向 parthanatos 而非 DNA 修復。

context.en-US: Hyperactivated PARP1 consumes NAD+ to synthesize poly(ADP-ribose) (PAR) chains on itself and chromatin targets; in parthanatos these chains accumulate to toxic levels and act as a death signal.
context.zh-TW: 過度活化的 PARP1 消耗 NAD+，在其自身與染色質目標上合成 poly(ADP-ribose)（PAR）鏈；在 parthanatos 中這些鏈累積至毒性濃度並作為死亡訊號。

context.en-US: Cytosolic PAR binds mitochondrial Apoptosis-Inducing Factor at Arg588, releasing it from the inner membrane and licensing its nuclear translocation together with MIF.
context.zh-TW: 細胞質 PAR 在 Arg588 結合粒線體 Apoptosis-Inducing Factor，將其從內膜釋放，並促使其與 MIF 共同轉位入核。

context.en-US: In male ischemic neurons, nNOS-derived peroxynitrite drives the DNA damage that hyperactivates PARP1; nNOS blockade protects males by cutting off parthanatos at its source.
context.zh-TW: 在雄性缺血神經元中，nNOS 衍生的 peroxynitrite 造成 DNA 損傷並使 PARP1 過度活化；阻斷 nNOS 可從源頭切斷 parthanatos，保護雄性。

context.en-US: PJ-34 is a PARP inhibitor that blocks parthanatos by preventing PARP1 hyperactivation and downstream PAR/AIF/MIF signaling; in stroke models it protects males only.
context.zh-TW: PJ-34 是 PARP 抑制劑，透過阻止 PARP1 過度活化及下游 PAR/AIF/MIF 訊號來阻斷 parthanatos；在中風模型中僅保護雄性。

context.en-US: Ferrostatin-1 is the defining ferroptosis inhibitor: a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant that halts lipid peroxidation propagation; rescue by Fer-1 is a diagnostic criterion for ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: Ferrostatin-1 是代表性的 ferroptosis 抑制劑：親脂性自由基捕捉抗氧化劑，可中止脂質過氧化鏈式反應；Fer-1 救援是 ferroptosis 的診斷標準。

context.en-US: Z-VAD-FMK is a pan-caspase inhibitor that blocks caspase-dependent apoptosis; persistence of death under Z-VAD-FMK argues for necroptosis, ferroptosis, or parthanatos instead.
context.zh-TW: Z-VAD-FMK 是泛 caspase 抑制劑，可阻斷 caspase 依賴的 apoptosis；在 Z-VAD-FMK 下仍發生的死亡指向 necroptosis、ferroptosis 或 parthanatos。

context.en-US: Q-VD-OPh is a neuroprotective pan-caspase inhibitor that blocks executioner Caspase-3; in ischemia models it protects females only, consistent with female-preferential caspase apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: Q-VD-OPh 是神經保護型泛 caspase 抑制劑，可阻斷執行者 Caspase-3；在缺血模型中僅保護雌性，與雌性偏好 caspase apoptosis 一致。

context.en-US: AIF induces chromatin condensation. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Chromatin condensation is a terminal morphologic hallmark of death in which DNA is compacted, classically by caspase or AIF action. The relationship is directional, with AIF acting as the operative agent upon chromatin condensation rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: AIF 誘發chromatin condensation。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。 chromatin condensation 是死亡的終末形態學標誌，其中 DNA 被壓縮，通常是透過 caspase 或 AIF 作用實現的。這種關係是有方向的，AIF 充當 chromatin condensation 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: AIF relates to MOMP through the relation is_released_from. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: AIF 透過關係式 is_released_from 與 MOMP 相關。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is inhibited by Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. The directionality runs from Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins toward Apoptosis, so Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 被 Apoptosis 抑制。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。方向性從Apoptosis向Apoptosis延伸，因此Apoptosis是活性劑，Apoptosis是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is induced by TRAIL. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. TRAIL (TNFSF10) is a death ligand that engages DR4 and DR5 to initiate extrinsic apoptosis with relative selectivity for malignant cells. The directionality runs from TRAIL toward Apoptosis, so TRAIL is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 由 TRAIL 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 TRAIL (TNFSF10) 是一種死亡配體，它與 DR4 和 DR5 結合以啟動外源性細胞凋亡，對惡性細胞具有相對選擇性。方向性從 TRAIL 向 Apoptosis，因此 TRAIL 是主動主體，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Apoptosome is composed of Apaf-1. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. Apaf-1 is the scaffolding adaptor of the apoptosome, containing CARD, NB-ARC, and WD40 domains that bind cytochrome c and recruit procaspase-9. The directionality runs from Apaf-1 toward Apoptosome, so Apaf-1 is the active agent and Apoptosome the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosome由Apaf-1組成。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。 Apaf-1 是凋亡體的支架接頭，包含結合 Cytochrome c 並募集 procaspase-9 的 CARD、NB-ARC 和 WD40 結構域。方向性從 Apaf-1 朝向 Apoptosome，因此 Apaf-1 是活性劑，Apoptosome 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Apoptosome is prevented by Bcl-2. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 toward Apoptosome, so Bcl-2 is the active agent and Apoptosome the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosome 被 Bcl-2 阻止。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。方向性從 Bcl-2 朝向 Apoptosome，因此 Bcl-2 是活性劑，Apoptosome 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Apoptosome activates Caspase-3. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosome acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-3 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosome 啟動 Caspase-3。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosome 充當 Caspase-3 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Apoptosome activates Caspase-9. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. context.en-US: Caspase-2 serves as the metabolic arm of the sirtuin-caspase crosstalk, linking cellular metabolic state to the apoptotic threshold. context.en-US: Caspase-9 is activated by c-ABL. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. c-ABL is a tyrosine kinase that, upon genotoxic stress, can phosphorylate and activate caspase-9 to promote apoptosis. The directionality runs from c-ABL toward Caspase-9, so c-ABL is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 由 c-ABL 活化。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 c-ABL 是一種酪胺酸激酶，在基因毒性壓力下，可以磷酸化並活化 caspase-9 以促進細胞凋亡。方向性從 c-ABL 朝向 Caspase-9，因此 c-ABL 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Caspase-9 activates Caspase-3. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-9 acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-3 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 啟動 Caspase-3。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-9 充當 Caspase-3 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Caspase-9 is inhibited by ERK. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. The directionality runs from ERK toward Caspase-9, so ERK is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 被 ERK 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。方向性從 ERK 朝向 Caspase-9，因此 ERK 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Caspase-9 is inhibited by p38 MAPK. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. p38 MAPK is a stress-activated kinase that can both promote and suppress apoptosis depending on context, including by phosphorylating caspases. The directionality runs from p38 MAPK toward Caspase-9, so p38 MAPK is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.

context.en-US: Caspase-9 is inhibited by PKCζ. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. PKCzeta is an atypical protein kinase C isoform that can phosphorylate and inhibit caspase-9 to blunt apoptosis. The directionality runs from PKCζ toward Caspase-9, so PKCζ is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 被 PKCζ 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 PKCzeta 是一種非典型蛋白激酶 C 同工型，可磷酸化並抑制 caspase-9 以抑制細胞凋亡。方向性從 PKCζ 向 Caspase-9，因此 PKCζ 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Caspase-9 is inhibited by XIAP. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. The directionality runs from XIAP toward Caspase-9, so XIAP is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 被 XIAP 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。方向性從 XIAP 朝向 Caspase-9，因此 XIAP 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins are overexpressed in Cancer. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins, so Cancer is the active agent and Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 中 Cancer 過度表現。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Cancer 延伸，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

context.en-US: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins relates to Caspase-3 through the relation inhibit. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-3 透過關係抑制與 Caspase-3 相關。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins relates to Caspase-7 through the relation inhibit. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. Caspase-7 is an executioner caspase closely related to caspase-3 that contributes to the proteolytic demolition of the cell. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-7 透過關係抑制與 Caspase-7 相關。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。 Caspase-7 是一種與 caspase-3 密切相關的劊子手 caspase，有助於細胞的蛋白水解破壞。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 透過關係抑制與 Caspase-9 相關。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins are antagonized by Smac-DIABLO. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. The directionality runs from Smac-DIABLO toward Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins, so Smac-DIABLO is the active agent and Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: 被 Smac-DIABLO 對抗。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。方向性從 Smac-DIABLO 朝向 ϵ，因此 Smac-DIABLO 是活性劑，並且 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Omi/HtrA2 antagonizes Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Omi/HtrA2 is a mitochondrial serine protease released at MOMP that both antagonizes IAPs and degrades substrates to promote death. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. The relationship is directional, with Omi/HtrA2 acting as the operative agent upon Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Omi/HtrA2 對抗Omi/HtrA2。 Omi/HtrA2 是一種在 MOMP 釋放的粒線體絲胺酸蛋白酶，它既可以拮抗 IAP，又可以降解底物以促進死亡。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。這種關係是有方向的，Omi/HtrA2 充當Omi/HtrA2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Pyroptosis is a form of programmed cell death distinct from apoptosis, although both are regulated cell-death modalities. In some contexts they are mutually regulated, for example when Ivermectin induces both apoptosis and autophagy alongside pyroptosis. Understanding their crosstalk matters for cancer therapy.
context.zh-TW: Pyroptosis 是與細胞凋亡不同的程式性細胞死亡形式，雖然兩者都是受調控的細胞死亡方式。在某些情境下它們互相調節，例如 Ivermectin 在誘導細胞焦亡的同時也誘導細胞凋亡與自噬。了解它們的交叉對話對癌症治療很重要。

context.en-US: Pyroptosis is initiated by the assembly of inflammasomes containing a pattern recognition receptor, ASC, and pro-caspase-1, which activates Caspase-1. Active Caspase-1 cleaves pro-IL-1beta and pro-IL-18 into mature forms and cleaves Gasdermin D to execute pyroptosis. Caspase-1 is therefore the central executor protease of pyroptosis.
context.zh-TW: Pyroptosis 由含有模式識別受體、ASC 和 pro-caspase-1 的發炎小體組裝所啟動，並激活 Caspase-1。活化的 Caspase-1 將 pro-IL-1beta 和 pro-IL-18 裂解為成熟形式，並裂解 Gasdermin D 以執行細胞焦亡。因此 Caspase-1 是細胞焦亡的核心執行蛋白酶。

context.en-US: Caspase-1 cleaves Gasdermin D, whose N-terminal fragment forms pores in the plasma membrane, executing pyroptosis. Pore formation leads to cell swelling and rupture with release of proinflammatory cytokines. Gasdermin D is thus the executioner of pyroptosis.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-1 裂解 Gasdermin D，其 N 端片段在質膜上形成孔洞，執行細胞焦亡。孔洞形成導致細胞腫脹與破裂，並釋放促發炎細胞因子。因此 Gasdermin D 是細胞焦亡的執行者。

context.en-US: NLRP3 is a common inflammasome involved in pyroptosis, functioning as an important component of innate immunity. Inflammasome assembly involving NLRP3 leads to Caspase-1 activation and pyroptotic cell death. NLRP3 thereby links inflammatory signaling to pyroptosis.
context.zh-TW: NLRP3 是參與細胞焦亡的常見發炎小體，是先天免疫的重要組成部分。涉及 NLRP3 的發炎小體組裝會導致 Caspase-1 激活與細胞焦亡性細胞死亡。因此 NLRP3 將發炎訊號與細胞焦亡連結起來。

context.en-US: Pyroptosis is a form of regulated (programmed) cell death induced by inflammasomes, distinct from apoptosis. It is characterized by cell swelling and rupturing, leading to the release of proinflammatory cytokines. Pyroptosis is therefore a distinct modality within regulated cell death.
context.zh-TW: Pyroptosis 是由發炎小體誘導的一種受調控（程式性）細胞死亡形式，與細胞凋亡不同。其特徵是細胞腫脹與破裂，導致促發炎細胞因子的釋放。因此 Pyroptosis 是受調控細胞死亡中的一種獨特形式。

context.en-US: Pyroptosis can inhibit tumor growth by inducing cell death and stimulating an inflammatory response in the tumor microenvironment. This positions pyroptosis as a tumor-suppressive modality in some contexts. Inducers such as Ivermectin have been observed to trigger pyroptosis in cancer cells.
context.zh-TW: Pyroptosis 可透過誘導細胞死亡並刺激腫瘤微環境中的發炎反應來抑制腫瘤生長。這使細胞焦亡在某些情境下成為腫瘤抑制形式。已觀察到 Ivermectin 等誘導劑可觸發癌細胞中的細胞焦亡。

context.en-US: Smac-DIABLO promotes Apoptosis. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Smac-DIABLO acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Smac-DIABLO 推廣 Apoptosis。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是定向的，Smac-DIABLO 充當 Apoptosis 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Smac-DIABLO synergizes with TRAIL. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. TRAIL (TNFSF10) is a death ligand that engages DR4 and DR5 to initiate extrinsic apoptosis with relative selectivity for malignant cells. The relationship is directional, with Smac-DIABLO acting as the operative agent upon TRAIL rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Smac-DIABLO 與 TRAIL 具有協同作用。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。 TRAIL (TNFSF10) 是一種死亡配體，它與 DR4 和 DR5 結合以啟動外源性細胞凋亡，對惡性細胞具有相對選擇性。這種關係是定向的，Smac-DIABLO 充當 TRAIL 的操作代理，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: AIF mediates caspase-independent cell death. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released via MOMP, drives chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation without caspase activation.
context.zh-TW: AIF 調節不依賴 caspase 的細胞死亡。Apoptosis 誘導因子是粒線體黃素蛋白，經 MOMP 釋放後，不經 caspase 活化即驅動 chromatin condensation 與 DNA 片段化。

context.en-US: TNFR1 death signaling assembles Complex II via TRADD/FADD to activate initiator caspase-8.
context.zh-TW: TNFR1 死亡訊號經 TRADD/FADD 組裝 Complex II 以活化起始 caspase-8。

context.en-US: TNFR1 Complex I drives the pro-survival inflammatory arm via NF-kB activation.
context.zh-TW: TNFR1 Complex I 經由 NF-κB 活化驅動促存活發炎分支。

context.en-US: Necroptosis is a NCCD-standard regulated death modality distinct from apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: Necroptosis 是與凋亡不同的 NCCD 標準受調控死亡形式。

context.en-US: Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent regulated death modality.
context.zh-TW: Ferroptosis 是鐵依賴的受調控死亡形式。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is the classic programmed arm of regulated cell death.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 是受調控細胞死亡的典型程序臂。

context.en-US: Glutathione keeps lipid peroxides sub-toxic via GPX4, suppressing ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: Glutathione 經 GPX4 使脂質過氧化物維持次毒性，抑制 Ferroptosis。

context.en-US: DAPK (death-associated protein kinase 1, DAPK1) inhibits RIPK1 activity by directly phosphorylating the RIPK1 protein, restraining tumors.
context.zh-TW: DAPK（死亡相關蛋白激酶1，DAPK1）透過直接磷酸化RIPK1蛋白來抑制RIPK1活性，進而抑制腫瘤。

context.en-US: ROS promote necroptosis by inducing RIPK1 autophosphorylation in septic cardiomyopathy and viral myocarditis.
context.zh-TW: ROS透過誘導RIPK1自身磷酸化來促進necroptosis，見於敗血性心肌病變與病毒性心肌炎。

context.en-US: Tyrosine phosphatase-6 (SHP1/PTPN6) dephosphorylates tyrosine residues on the RIPK1 protein in tumors and inflammatory disease.
context.zh-TW: 酪胺酸磷酸酶-6（SHP1/PTPN6）可去磷酸化RIPK1蛋白上的酪胺酸殘基，調控腫瘤與發炎性疾病中的necroptosis。

context.en-US: The PI3K/Akt pathway suppresses RIPK1-dependent necroptosis by phosphorylating and inhibiting RIPK1 kinase activity.
context.zh-TW: PI3K/Akt路徑透過磷酸化並抑制RIPK1激酶活性，來抑制RIPK1依賴的necroptosis。

context.en-US: TRIM21 directly interacts with RIPK1 and ubiquitinates it through its RING domain, regulating antiviral immunity and autoimmunity.
context.zh-TW: TRIM21直接與RIPK1交互作用，並透過其RING結構域泛素化RIPK1，調控抗病毒免疫與自體免疫。

context.en-US: Cylindromatosis (CYLD) modulates the ubiquitination status of RIPK1, gating neuroinflammation and hyperinflammatory syndromes.
context.zh-TW: 圓柱瘤蛋白（CYLD）調控RIPK1的泛素化狀態，掌控神經發炎與全身性高發炎症候群。

context.en-US: Phosphorylation of OTULIN at Tyr-56 regulates RIPK1 ubiquitination and drives necroptotic cell death in inflammation.
context.zh-TW: OTULIN在Tyr-56的磷酸化可調控RIPK1泛素化，並在發炎中驅動necroptosis細胞死亡。

context.en-US: Caspase-6 promotes the ZBP1-RIPK3 inflammatory response through interaction with RIPK3 in viral infection.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-6透過與RIPK3交互作用，促進ZBP1-RIPK3觸發的發炎反應，見於病毒感染性疾病。

context.en-US: ZBP1 recruits RIPK3 via its RHIM domain, causing RIPK3 autophosphorylation in viral, inflammatory, and reproductive disorders.
context.zh-TW: ZBP1透過其RHIM結構域招募RIPK3，引起RIPK3自身磷酸化，見於病毒感染、發炎性疾病與生殖系統疾病。

context.en-US: TRIF binds the RHIM domain of RIPK3, directly activating downstream necroptosis in infection, inflammation, and tumors.
context.zh-TW: TRIF結合RIPK3的RHIM結構域，直接活化下游necroptosis，見於感染、發炎損傷與腫瘤。

context.en-US: RSK3 acts upstream of RIPK3 phosphorylation, promoting necroptosis in ischemic retinal injury.
context.zh-TW: RSK3作為RIPK3磷酸化的上游調控因子，促進necroptosis活化，見於缺血性視網膜損傷。

context.en-US: Casein kinase 1G2 binds RIPK3 to inhibit its kinase activity and necroptosis signaling in male reproductive aging.
context.zh-TW: 酪蛋白激酶1G2結合RIPK3以抑制其激酶活性與下游necroptosis訊號，見於雄性生殖老化。

context.en-US: RIPK3 phosphorylates and activates CaMKII, triggering necroptosis or neuroprotection in cardiac and neurological injury.
context.zh-TW: RIPK3磷酸化並活化CaMKII，觸發necroptosis或抑制興奮性毒性以發揮神經保護作用，見於心肌缺血再灌注損傷、心衰竭與神經損傷。

context.en-US: RIPK3 phosphorylates threonine 135 on the E3 subunit of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, enhancing PDC activity in cancer.
context.zh-TW: RIPK3磷酸化丙酮酸去氫酶複合體E3次單元的蘇胺酸135，增強PDC催化活性，見於癌症。

context.en-US: PGAM5 activated by RIPK3 phosphorylation dephosphorylates Drp1, promoting mitochondrial fission in ischemia-reperfusion and neurodegeneration.
context.zh-TW: 經RIPK3磷酸化活化的PGAM5去磷酸化Drp1，促進粒線體分裂，見於缺血再灌注損傷與神經退化性疾病。

context.en-US: Bromodomain protein 4 positively regulates necroptosis by transcriptionally controlling MLKL expression.
context.zh-TW: 溴結構域蛋白4透過轉錄調控MLKL表現，正向調控necroptosis。

context.en-US: Heat shock protein 90 binds MLKL, preventing proteasomal degradation and promoting MLKL activation and membrane translocation.
context.zh-TW: 熱休克蛋白90結合MLKL，防止其經蛋白酶體降解，並促進MLKL活化與膜轉位。

context.en-US: RIPK1 directly phosphorylates MLKL under specific conditions, particularly in mouse inflammation models.
context.zh-TW: RIPK1在特定條件下（特別是小鼠細胞）可直接磷酸化MLKL，見於發炎模型。

context.en-US: During phagocytosis, TAM kinases (Tyro3, Axl, Mer) activated by phosphatidylserine directly phosphorylate MLKL in inflammatory disease.
context.zh-TW: 吞噬作用期間，經磷脂醯絲胺酸活化的TAM激酶（Tyro3、Axl、Mer）可直接磷酸化MLKL，見於發炎相關疾病。

context.en-US: BAX and BAK oligomerize into macropores in a subset of mitochondria during senescence, releasing mtDNA and mt-dsRNA into the cytosol; this sublethal minority MOMP drives SASP without causing cell death.
context.zh-TW: BAX 與 BAK 在衰老過程中於部分粒線體寡聚形成大孔，將 mtDNA 與 mt-dsRNA 釋放到胞質；這種亞致死性 minority MOMP 在不引起細胞死亡的情況下驅動 SASP。

context.en-US: Pharmacologic BAX inhibitors BAI1 and eltrombopag block BAX translocation and oligomerization, reducing cytosolic mtDNA/mtRNA and SASP secretion in senescent fibroblasts; in aged mice BAI1 lowers circulating SASP factors and improves bone strength and frailty without altering p16/p21 arrest.
context.zh-TW: 藥理學 BAX 抑制劑 BAI1 與 eltrombopag 阻斷 BAX 轉位與寡聚，減少衰老纖維母細胞的胞質 mtDNA/mtRNA 與 SASP 分泌；在老齡小鼠中 BAI1 降低循環 SASP 因子並改善骨強度與衰弱，且不改變 p16/p21 停滯。

context.en-US: Necroptotic plasma-membrane rupture spills intracellular contents — HMGB1, ATP, mitochondrial DNA — that are recognized as DAMPs by TLRs and inflammasomes; the DAMP release is the defining inflammatory payoff that separates necroptosis from silent apoptosis (Dhuriya & Sharma 2018).
context.zh-TW: Necroptotic 質膜破裂釋出胞內內容物（HMGB1、ATP、粒線體 DNA），被 TLR 與炎症小體辨識為 DAMP；DAMP 釋放是區分 necroptosis 與無聲凋亡的關鍵發炎特徵（Dhuriya & Sharma 2018）。

context.en-US: DAMP release plus direct RIPK3-dependent inflammasome activation (caspase-8- and NLRP3-mediated arms) make necroptosis intrinsically pro-inflammatory; uncontrolled necroptosis converts host defense into chronic necroinflammatory disease.
context.zh-TW: DAMP 釋放加上 RIPK3 直接驅動的炎症小體活化（caspase-8 與 NLRP3 兩臂）使 necroptosis 本質上促發炎；失控的 necroptosis 將宿主防禦轉為慢性壞死性發炎疾病。

context.en-US: RIPK1 recruits RIPK3 through RHIM interactions to assemble the necrosome; RIPK1 kinase activity then phosphorylates RIPK3, the obligatory relay of the necroptotic cascade.
context.zh-TW: RIPK1 經 RHIM 交互作用招募 RIPK3 組裝 necrosome；RIPK1 激酶活性隨後磷酸化 RIPK3，為 necroptosis 級聯的必需接續步驟。

context.en-US: RIPK3 phosphorylates MLKL (human Thr357/Ser358) to license its oligomerization and membrane-pore formation, the terminal executor step of necroptosis.
context.zh-TW: RIPK3 磷酸化 MLKL（人類 Thr357/Ser358），准許其寡聚化並形成膜孔，為 necroptosis 的末端執行步驟。

context.en-US: TNFα binding to TNFR1 nucleates Complex I (TRADD/RIPK1/TRAF2/cIAPs/NEMO-IKK) for NF-κB survival signaling; when NF-κB output is blocked and caspase-8 inhibited the same receptor licenses the necrosome.
context.zh-TW: TNFα 結合 TNFR1 組裝 Complex I（TRADD/RIPK1/TRAF2/cIAPs/NEMO-IKK）啟動 NF-κB 生存訊號；當 NF-κB 受阻且 caspase-8 被抑制時，同一受體轉而准許 necrosome 形成。

context.en-US: Acinar necrosis in cerulein-induced pancreatitis is driven in large part by necroptosis: supramaximal cerulein hyperstimulation activates RIPK3, whose phosphorylation of MLKL ruptures acinar membranes; RIPK3 or MLKL deletion attenuates severity.
context.zh-TW: cerulein 誘導胰臟炎的腺泡壞死主要由 necroptosis 驅動：超最大量 cerulein 過度刺激活化 RIPK3，其磷酸化 MLKL 使腺泡膜破裂；RIPK3 或 MLKL 缺失可減輕嚴重度。

context.en-US: Acinar necroptosis in CIP releases DAMPs (HMGB1 etc.) that spill into the circulation and escalate local pancreatitis into systemic inflammatory response syndrome.
context.zh-TW: CIP 中腺泡 necroptosis 釋出 DAMP（如 HMGB1）進入循環，使局部胰臟炎惡化為全身性發炎反應症候群（SIRS）。

context.en-US: RIPK3 deletion attenuates acinar necrosis, edema, and serum amylase in cerulein-induced pancreatitis, supporting a causal necroptotic component.
context.zh-TW: RIPK3 缺失減輕 cerulein 誘導胰臟炎的腺泡壞死、水腫與血清澱粉酶，支持 necroptosis 的因果角色。

context.en-US: MLKL oligomerization is the proposed executor of acinar plasma-membrane rupture in cerulein-induced pancreatitis, but MLKL knockout does not consistently reduce CIP severity (He et al. 2015), suggesting RIPK3 may act through MLKL-independent substrates in this model.
context.zh-TW: MLKL 寡聚化是 CIP 中腺泡質膜破裂的假定執行者，但 MLKL 敲除並未一致降低 CIP 嚴重度（He et al. 2015），提示 RIPK3 可能在此模型中透過 MLKL 非依賴底物作用。

context.en-US: RIPK1 inhibition with Necrostatin-1 attenuates acinar necrosis, edema, and serum amylase in cerulein-induced pancreatitis, confirming RIPK1 dependence of the necroptotic component.
context.zh-TW: 在 CIP 中以 Necrostatin-1 抑制 RIPK1 可減輕腺泡壞死、水腫與血清澱粉酶，證實該 necroptotic 成分依賴 RIPK1。

context.en-US: Necrostatin-1s (Nec-1s) is the second-generation allosteric RIPK1 inhibitor: the same mechanism as Necrostatin-1 with improved metabolic stability and kinase selectivity.
context.zh-TW: Necrostatin-1s（Nec-1s）為第二代 RIPK1 異位抑制劑：機制與 Nec-1 相同，但代謝穩定性與激酶選擇性更佳。

context.en-US: By blocking RIPK1 kinase activity, Nec-1s prevents necrosome assembly and therefore RIPK3-MLKL necroptosis in vivo and in vitro.
context.zh-TW: 透過阻斷 RIPK1 激酶活性，Nec-1s 阻止 necrosome 組裝，進而抑制 RIPK3-MLKL necroptosis。

context.en-US: Nec-1s was developed as the second-generation successor to Necrostatin-1, retaining the RIPK1-targeting scaffold while eliminating the indoleamine-2,3-dioxygenase (IDO) off-target activity of the first-generation compound.
context.zh-TW: Nec-1s 為 Nec-1 的第二代後繼化合物，保留靶向 RIPK1 的骨架，同時消除第一代化合物的 IDO 非靶標活性。

context.en-US: Active caspase-8 (often as the caspase-8/cFLIP-L heterodimer) cleaves RIPK1 to terminate necrosome signaling; its inhibition is a key precondition for necroptosis (Dhuriya & Sharma 2018).
context.zh-TW: 活化型 caspase-8（常為 caspase-8/cFLIP-L 異二聚體）切割 RIPK1 以終止 necrosome 訊號；其被抑制是 necroptosis 的關鍵前提之一（Dhuriya & Sharma 2018）。

context.en-US: Active caspase-8 cleaves RIPK3 as well as RIPK1, disassembling the necrosome and blocking necroptosis; genetic loss of this cleavage is epistatically rescued by RIPK3/MLKL knockout.
context.zh-TW: 活化型 caspase-8 同樣切割 RIPK3 與 RIPK1，拆解 necrosome 並阻斷 necroptosis；此切割的遺傳缺失可由 RIPK3/MLKL 敲除表型挽救。
